name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Accordion and expandable lists of sections, plus the popout style and a single collapsible section.
improvements: Headers are real buttons inside headings with aria-expanded and aria-controls, so screen readers announce the state.
Arrow keys, Home and End move between headers (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern).
Smooth 300ms height animation that measures content with no jQuery slideDown, and none under reduced motion.
Controlled and uncontrolled open state for accordion and expandable modes.
Visible keyboard focus on headers and a rotating expand chevron.
